description:
Title: Full Stack Engineer 
 Location: Sunnyvale, CA 
 Duration: 6 week contract 
 Interview: Phone and Skype 
 The team is building a native app for one of the MX brands. 80% of the features have been developed, Pranay needs a handy full stack developer who can push completion of the last 20% of creation and fully manage cloud deployments and launch. They need to be able to work on all aspects of launch “last mile," limited resources for this particular app development/launch.
 After this project, there’s a strong possibility to work on other items having to do with the other 4 brands being managed by this team for Client.
 TOP SKILLS: 
 Experience/exposure to ReactJS 
 Experience/exposure to NodeJS – deployments in cloud 
 Experience/exposure to developing/launching scalable high traffic high volume Web Applications 
 Ability to utilize MongoDB, Google Analytics , other tools to launch the App
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 - Some experience/exposure to React-Native 
 - 3+ years of experience with ReactJS, AngularJS .
 - 3+ years of experience with NodeJS 
 - 3+ years of experience building highly scalable, high performance, responsive web applications.
 - 5+ years of experience and sold fundamental’s in front end web technologies including and not limited to HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript.
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced and agile development environment.
 - Strong customer focus and obsession with quality.
 Additional Preferred Qualifications 
 - Solid understanding of github and open source development culture in general. 
 - Experience with Oracle ATG e-commerce solutions.
 - Experience with Microsoft .NET 
 - A passion for all things Web, including but not limited to, managing applications in the cloud, building and maintaining RESTful API’s, database design, development and maintenance, network engineering, web performance, analytics and monitoring.
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 Position Highlights 
 - Collaborate: Work closely with talented engineers and product visionaries to take the client properties to the next level.
 - Feel involved: your ideas count, collaborate with the team to conceptualize, rapidly prototype and deliver the best online shopping experience features for our customers.
 - Make an impact: build and maintain a premium e-commerce shopping experience for million’s of customers across 5+ properties in the Mexico market.
 - Learn and Grow: opportunity to learn a very unique e-commerce market, it’s customers and technologies and utilize that base understanding to drive innovation and value. 
 About the Team 
 Join the web front end team and reach millions of people globally. client has a unique real-world connection to millions of people around the world, guided by a mission to help people live better by saving money. Client is the #1 retailer in the world, with a unique real-world connection to people, guided by the mission to help people live better lives by saving money. 
 As a Senior Front End Software Engineer for client eCommerce, you'll be responsible for large-scale, e-commerce Web applications development and maintenance. You'll interact with the business to provide robust technical solutions to business problems; you will interact with junior engineers to provide guidance as to best practices in web development. This position will support our efforts in front-end web development team.
 The Client International team delivers the product roadmap and engineering capabilities across every device for our international businesses in the UK , Canada and Mexico. The group has a global mandate, so our experiences touch lives around the world. This is an opportunity to solve complex challenges for Mexico’s eCommerce needs.

 TOP SKILLS: 
 Experience/exposure to ReactJS 
 Experience/exposure to NodeJS – deployments in cloud 
 Experience/exposure to developing/launching scalable high traffic high volume Web Applications 
 Ability to utilize MongoDB, Google Analytics , other tools to launch the App

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
